name: Read URL
description: Opens a web address and reads the main text of that page.
capabilities: Opens a web address and reads the main text, leaving out menus, headers, and footers.

built_in_toggle.shared_description: Optional. When web search is also on, the assistant can open a link and read the main text of that page. Menus, headers, and footers are left out. Turn this off if you do not want pages opened. Shared by every assistant.
built_in_toggle.profile_disable_description: Optional. Tick this to stop this assistant from opening web pages. Other assistants are not changed. Leave it unticked to keep page reading on.
